items.Sentence: Primary treatment consists of 2-millimeter (mm) drum screens with a bypass channel/bar with screens
and a vortex grit removal mechanism.
Each bioreactor train consists of two anoxic zones followed by one aerobic zone with two aeration grids.
Flow from the aerobic zone is pumped to the membrane filtration units, which provide tertiary treatment.
The tertiary-treated effluent is disinfected using an ultraviolet light (UV) disinfection system.
Solids are passed through a solids reduction process utilizing interchange tanks.
Following the interchange tanks, the reduced solids are purged into the digester, which holds the solids for 10 to 15 days.
After detainment in the digester, the solids are sent to dewatering equipment, which includes a centrifuge.

The dewatered biosolids are hauled off-site to the Clovis Municipal Solid Waste Landfill. As a backup option, the biosolids could be hauled to a Class B Solids land application facility or a composting facility.
